label: Linear Algebra
shortDescription: A free university linear algebra course: systems, matrices, determinants, vector spaces, linear maps, eigenvalues, orthogonality, inner product spaces, the spectral theorem, and the SVD.
modulesDescription: Read the linear algebra chapters in order, or jump directly to the topic you need.
ogTitle: Learn Linear Algebra for Free | CalcPath

topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations
topics.description: Row reduction, Gaussian elimination, solution structure, rank, and the LU factorization.

topics.title: Vectors and Euclidean Space
topics.description: Vector arithmetic, the dot and cross products, projections, and the geometry of lines and planes.

topics.title: Matrix Algebra
topics.description: Matrix operations, inverses, elementary and block matrices, and the Invertible Matrix Theorem.

topics.title: Determinants
topics.description: The permutation definition, cofactor expansion, multiplicativity, the adjugate, Cramer's rule, and volume.

topics.title: Vector Spaces
topics.description: Abstract vector spaces over a field, subspaces, bases, dimension, coordinates, and the four fundamental subspaces.

topics.title: Linear Transformations
topics.description: Kernel and image, matrices relative to bases, change of basis, similarity, and isomorphism.

topics.title: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors
topics.description: The characteristic polynomial, diagonalization, complex eigenvalues, powers, and Markov chains.

topics.title: Generalized Eigenvectors and Jordan Form
topics.description: Minimal polynomials, the Cayley-Hamilton theorem, generalized eigenvectors, Jordan normal form, and the matrix exponential.

topics.title: Orthogonality and Least Squares
topics.description: Orthogonal sets, projections, Gram-Schmidt, QR, and least-squares fitting.

topics.title: Inner Product Spaces
topics.description: Abstract inner products, norms, orthogonal polynomials, Fourier approximation, and complex Hermitian and unitary matrices.

topics.title: Symmetric Matrices and Quadratic Forms
topics.description: The Spectral Theorem, quadratic forms, and positive definite matrices.

topics.title: The Singular Value Decomposition
topics.description: Singular values, the SVD, the pseudoinverse, low-rank approximation, and principal component analysis.

courseDescription: Free university linear algebra course covering linear systems, matrix algebra, determinants, abstract vector spaces, linear transformations, eigenvalues and Jordan form, orthogonality and least squares, inner product spaces, symmetric matrices and quadratic forms, and the singular value decomposition. Every chapter has definitions, proofs, worked examples, and practice problems with step-by-step solutions.
ogDescription: Free university linear algebra course. Matrices, vector spaces, eigenvalues, orthogonality, and the SVD — 12 textbook-depth chapters with proofs, worked examples, and practice problems with full solutions.
